nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Cut out products, people, or clothing from a source image using an upstream background-removal model.

clothClass.description: Apparel classes used only when subType is 9. Multiple values may be comma-separated. Supported values: tops, coat, skirt, pants, bag, shoes, hat.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image to cut out. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

name: nexscope_background_remover
title: Background Remover API
